activation_trace.assigned_role: Grounds the subject's witness-role in firsthand presence rather than hearsay.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: Presence together with direct witnessing or seeing.

changed_reading.after: The subject is present to the matter indicated by ذَٰلِكَ and witnesses it from direct proximity.
changed_reading.before: An unspecified subject is called a witness concerning an unspecified matter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَهِيدٌ, root ش ه د, through root_000822/B001; the construction عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ places the pronominal subject in an evidentiary relation to an unspecified matter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The witness is present with the matter and sees it directly. Its force comes from participation or immediate observation, not from receiving a report.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Makes the subject a bearer and discloser of evidence concerning ذَٰلِكَ.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A statement, acknowledgement, or decisive report made from knowledge.

changed_reading.after: The subject bears articulate, knowledge-based testimony concerning that matter.
changed_reading.before: The predicate may mean only that the subject has seen something.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَهِيدٌ, root ش ه د, through root_000822/B002, with عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ supplying the matter about or against which testimony bears.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge is converted into a decisive declaration, acknowledgement, or proof-bearing judgment. The witness does not merely perceive; it makes what is known evidentially available.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Shifts testimony from a courtroom-like utterance to self-disclosing expression.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A tongue or visible expression that reveals its owner.

changed_reading.after: The subject's own expression can speak evidentially about the subject, even before deliberate confession.
changed_reading.before: The subject deliberately reports what it knows.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَهِيدٌ, root ش ه د, through root_000822/B005; this branch allows a tongue or outward expression to stand as its owner's witness.
baseline_models.mechanism: An expression can testify about its source independently of a formal declaration. The subject's outward articulation is therefore capable of exposing the subject.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Allows the subject itself to be evidence of the matter designated by ذَٰلِكَ.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: A visible sign that testifies to a time, state, or quality.

changed_reading.after: The subject can be a standing evidentiary sign whose condition testifies without a separate speech act.
changed_reading.before: Witnesshood is a conscious act of seeing or speaking.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: شَهِيدٌ, root ش ه د, through root_000822/B008; the nominal predicate can characterize the subject as an enduring sign of a condition or quality.
baseline_models.mechanism: A visible condition functions indexically: it points beyond itself to the state that produced it. Witnesshood can thus reside in what the subject is or displays, not only in what the subject says.

alternatives: ضَبْحًا may remain vivid scene texture without evidentiary force.
شَهِيدٌ may still denote deliberate testimony rather than bodily disclosure.
abductive_moves.assumption: The panting is generated by the running and reliably indexes its intensity.
abductive_moves.packet_supplies: عَٰدِيَٰتِ with the running image root_000993/B002, ضَبْحًا with the sound image root_000901/B001, and the witnessing-expression image root_000822/B005.
abductive_moves.reader_infers: Running causes panting; panting then serves as testimony emitted by the moving body.

context_deltas.ablation: Without ضَبْحًا as emitted sound, running alone leaves only an observer model; without root_000822/B005, the sound remains atmosphere rather than the body's testimony.

activation_trace.assigned_role: Receives the panting as an embodied, non-propositional tongue.
activation_trace.literal_contribution: An expression can reveal the one from whom it issues.
